---
title: "Time-Reversible Reflection-Invariant System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& -yz\\
\dot{y} &=& axz+yz+z^3\\
\dot{z} &=& x-x^3
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=2$ and initial condition $(-1,1,-1)$.
